description: Serviço Python de TTS (Kokoro / Edge-TTS / Google Cloud TTS) com comutador de provider.
name: @shorts-forge/tts

scripts.test: if [ ! -x service/.venv/bin/python ]; then echo 'tts: venv Python em falta — testes adiados. Instala com: python3 -m venv service/.venv && service/.venv/bin/pip install -r service/requirements.txt'; else service/.venv/bin/python -m pytest service/tests -q -m "not live"; fi
